keyChanges.title: Nevada NTA grants 5,000-vehicle Clark County robotaxi permit
keyChanges.description: The Nevada Transportation Authority voted on August 20 to raise Tesla's Clark County robotaxi cap. Tesla's own Cybercab lead said they will not fill 5,000 in 12 months; first vehicles are Model Y; zero in paid Las Vegas service.

positive_signals: NTA voted a 5,000-vehicle Clark County permit
Paper cap is larger than the prior 10-vehicle Strip cap
Tesla can theoretically stage more Model Y robotaxis
Permit is a real regulatory document
Date of vote is new vs last week
negative_signals: Tesla Cybercab lead said they will not fill 5,000 in 12 months
First vehicles are Model Y, not Cybercab
Zero vehicles in paid Las Vegas service
No launch date for paid Strip rides
Paper permit does not move the verified fleet print

considered.title: Nevada NTA 5,000-vehicle permit
considered.reason: new NTA vote vs last week's 10-vehicle cap
